<objective>
Claim a tracker issue by assigning it to the current user, so a project board's status-sync automation moves the card to In progress on its own — the board follows the assignment rather than being edited by hand

Phases:

- assign: Assign the issue to the current user, via the project's configured wrapper if it declares one, otherwise `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`
- verify: Confirm the assignment landed and, when a status-sync workflow is configured, that its run concluded successfully — never edit the board's Status field directly
  </objective>
